title: Restricted decision tree depth bound
statement: Let $n,m\in\mathbb N$, let $f_0,\ldots,f_{m-1}$ be Boolean functions on the sign cube of dimension $n$, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and fix signs on the coordinates outside $J$. For each $i<m$, the decision tree depth of the restriction of $f_i$ with those fixed signs is at most the maximum of these restricted depths over all $i<m$.
